notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable embedded temporal-role development slice to source-derived IEEE 1516.1-2025 records. It keeps Enable Time Regulation and Enable Time Constrained pending until their respective standard callback is dispatched; stores the requested lookahead only when time regulation becomes enabled; exposes Query Lookahead; and clears the corresponding mode on Disable. Relevant role state changes re-evaluate the separate limited no-TSO TAR scheduler. The current callback time is the federate's current time only because this closed development profile has no TSO send/receive services or timestamped queues. It has no TSO delivery/order, asynchronous delivery, Modify Lookahead, full enable-time coordination, save/restore, package support, catalog result, JUnit sidecar, protected review, or conformance claim.
